name: Cleo
self_text: I’m a late‑30s Italian woman, economist by training, who loves knitting in my spare time. I’m currently studying language practice and thrive when I study independently, side by side with someone. I’m looking for a partner who can explain things to me during our sessions. I’m available for online meetings on Saturday mornings or Saturday afternoons. Outside the classroom I enjoy the quiet joy of knitting, feeling creative and relaxed. I like to keep things simple and focused, and I appreciate a calm, supportive learning environment.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into language practice and you must be available any of Saturday afternoon or Saturday morning. I'd strongly prefer that you are the one who explains the material to me, though that’s not a requirement. It would be a small bonus if you are into studying independently side by side or if we overlap on online, but I won’t rule you out over it.
